remark: The exception occurs when URLDecoder.decode processes a substring that contains invalid percent-encoding, such as incomplete percent sequences (e.g., '%2') or invalid hexadecimal digits (e.g., '%GG'). Since the input dataString comes from external sources (login URL), malformed escape sequences are possible and are not checked before decoding.
